name: Readable calendars, clearer financials, and synchronized crosshairs
body:
## Highlights

- **More room for event names.** The Economic Calendar gives names more space in narrow panes, keeps ordinary figures readable, and shows the full name and figures when you open a row. (#3052, #3056, #3063)
- **The accounting basis stays visible.** Financial Analysis shows which reporting basis a series uses, and listing valuations no longer borrow earnings from a predecessor company. (#3003, #3028, #3040, #3046)
- **More panes follow a pinned time.** Pin the crosshair from a chart above a table and keep that time in view in linked panes, even when they don't have focus. (#3038)
- **See which price sizes a position.** `KELLY` uses the regular-session valuation price for stocks and ETFs and shows the session and timestamp. (#3039)

## Also in this release

- Filings and ownership views link to more issuer disclosures across Asian markets. (#3031, #3033, #3035, #3037, #3049, #3051, #3053)
- On Windows, CLI commands that save user data can wait longer when the database is busy. (#3061)
- Position imports skip retired or ambiguous listings rather than substituting a different security; comparison exports retain the input rows, including duplicates and unavailable quotes. (#3062)
- Open the dilution and custody guides directly from the app. (#3064)

[Full diff](https://github.com/gloom-sh/gloomberb/compare/v0.20.22...v0.20.23)
